content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-97 means CPT 93271 was bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable, and there is no current denial on the table to support another appeal or peer-to-peer request. Resubmission would risk a duplicate denial, while the balance is not a proper patient liability merely because deductible remains; with no secondary payer, no collectible balance remains.","action":"write_off"}
